caveats.text: Odd/even eclipse-depth z-score is 7.43 (gate > 3.0): alternating eclipses differ significantly in depth, the signature of a true period double what BLS found. Pixel-check confirmation and eclipse timing are unaffected - report the corrected period, 4.485152 d, in any write-up.

The ON_TARGET call rests on a neighbour-competition margin of just 0.030 px (dimming centroid 0.203 px from target vs 0.233 px from the nearest bright-enough neighbour) - inside diag_pixel.py's own stated centroid systematic of 0.10-0.3 px. TESS's resolution cannot confidently separate this star from that neighbour.
